n1.text: Direction: light paper ground, ink type, one highlighter-yellow accent used like a text selection. Type tags keep the app's real colours. Sections are numbered ⌘1–⌘7 like the app's quick-copy keys. No marquee band, no outline giant word, no blue CTA block.

n2.text: Try it: a working model of ClipStack in the page. Copy (button or real ⌘C on the notes), open with ⇧⌘V or the button, ↑↓ / type / Tab, ↩ puts it on the demo clipboard, ⌘V in the reply pastes it. A five-step checklist ticks as each move is learned. Phones: tap Copy, tap Open, tap an entry to paste. Labelled as an in-browser model; it never touches the real clipboard.
